instructions: Score 0–1 as the sum of five components; award each proportionally to supported completeness, explaining deductions. (1) Fidelity, 0.30: database account identity/ownership, request scope, meeting decisions/updates; comparable dated valuations, qualifiers, no invented facts or precision. (2) Actions and funding, 0.25: agreed actions/retentions, source/destination/ownership, amount/allocation, full/partial extent, timing/conditions; separate holdings, proposed products and funding, deduct commitments once, exclude contingent funds, explain material exclusions, never count transfers as new wealth or duplicate proceeds. (3) Structure and coverage, 0.20: correct section inclusion/order and slot placement; scoped holdings once, high-level background, supported explanations, fixed wording exactly once where declared, no whole-report leakage or repeated openings. (4) Fees, tax and uncertainty, 0.15: sourced initial charges including zero; separate outstanding platform/advice confirmations; tax only for supported potentially taxable disposals, supplied annual-exempt wording and human confirmation, no estimated CGT; missing evidence remains visible without treating generation defects as adviser tasks. (5) Client usefulness, 0.10: clear supported suitability, sensitive circumstances handled appropriately, concise British English, no filler or duplicated explanations. List every material defect, conflict, missing required item or judgement needing human resolution in concerns; do not hide concerns in rationale. Evidence supports claims; expectations identify required checks, never license unsupported claims. If they conflict or a required check is impossible, state the gap and withhold that component's credit. Any hard failure caps score at 0.49 and must appear in concerns; scoring never changes hard-check results. Any concern prevents promotion until explicitly reviewed by a human. An empty concerns list is not approval.
